title: PPIA-16 Developer Console Action Contracts
purpose: Define deterministic enablement, confirmation, execution, result and recovery contracts for the eight Foundation action classes. PPIA-16 coordinates existing authority; it never creates mutation authority.
global_action_invariants: Every action displays repository/ref/candidate, owning source, scope and raw prerequisite state before execution.
Disabled actions expose the exact blocking reason and the next permissible observation/recovery action.
No action may silently widen scope, substitute a later candidate, fabricate missing authority, or weaken assertions to obtain PASS.
Ambiguous mutation status is never retried blindly; operation/status lookup or repository recovery is required first.
Generated artifacts and evidence outputs are labeled with their authority class and destination/overwrite semantics.
Owner-gated actions remain disabled until an explicit owner decision exists in the owning gate; PPIA-16 itself cannot satisfy that gate.
Keyboard, nonvisual, touch and mobile controls expose the same action name, authority, confirmation requirement and blocking state.

actions.label: Observe / refresh
disable_when: continuity conflict requires selecting/reconciling source first
actions.execution_contract: Read or invoke the declared observation only; preserve raw PASS/WARN/FAIL/BLOCK or source lifecycle state.

result_contract.success: refresh displayed source-bound observation and receipt when the tool defines one
result_contract.failure: show raw failure/error and preserve last verified evidence as historical/stale, not current

actions.retry: safe only for idempotent read/observation; candidate identity is re-resolved before retry
actions.keyboard: single explicit command; Enter/Space activates; refresh never steals focus
actions.mobile_touch: explicit text label; pull-to-refresh may duplicate but never replace the accessible Refresh action

actions.label: Open governing source / evidence
disable_when: target locator is absent or protected
actions.execution_contract: Open exact repository/ref/path/run identity without rewriting it to a convenient nearby source.

result_contract.success: destination identity remains visible and back-navigation restores prior task state
result_contract.failure: retain locator and expose open/copy alternative when safe

actions.keyboard: link semantics with meaningful accessible name including source class where ambiguity exists

actions.label: Generate development artifact
enable_when: output destination is explicit when writing
overwrite policy is explicit when target exists
disable_when: generation would fill missing governance authority
actions.confirmation: required before overwrite or multi-file output; otherwise destination preview is sufficient
actions.execution_contract: Generate only the declared artifact/transformation. Source authority, stop conditions and nonauthoritative classification are embedded in output metadata where supported.

result_contract.success: show path/digest/classification and whether overwrite occurred
result_contract.failure: do not present partial output as complete; list created/unchanged paths deterministically

actions.retry: allowed after resolving destination/inputs; never overwrite implicitly
actions.keyboard: destination and overwrite controls are reachable before Generate
actions.mobile_touch: summary confirmation includes destination and artifact authority class

actions.label: Run deterministic validation/evidence tool
enable_when: tool inputs and scope are valid
candidate/source identity is bound when required
required adapter is not needed or is separately satisfied
actions.confirmation: none for read-only deterministic runs; explicit scope review for expensive/large evidence runs
actions.execution_contract: Invoke the named DT tool/hosted validator without changing its assertions; stream concise status while preserving final raw result and exact inputs.

result_contract.failure: preserve raw FAIL/BLOCK findings and logs without downgrading them

actions.retry: permitted for deterministic read/evidence runs after candidate/input rebinding; failed mutation-adjacent adapters follow adapter contract
actions.keyboard: Run and Cancel/Stop when supported are distinct labeled controls; focus returns to result heading
actions.mobile_touch: progress never hides candidate or stop/cancel state

actions.label: Invoke explicit external adapter
actions.confirmation: always required when adapter can mutate external/application state; review adapter identity, target, candidate, scope and authority
actions.execution_contract: Console passes only declared inputs to the adapter; adapter owns mutation semantics. No implicit fallback to simulation when product evidence is required.

result_contract.success: preserve adapter raw result plus tool receipt/limitations
result_contract.failure: BLOCK or FAIL remains explicit; uncertain mutation outcome enters recovery/status lookup

actions.retry: never blind-retry an adapter with possible mutation; verify operation status/idempotency first
actions.keyboard: confirmation dialog has explicit Review/Execute/Cancel order and initial focus on heading, not Execute
actions.mobile_touch: two-step review prevents accidental adjacent-tap execution

actions.label: Prepare governed repository/application action
enable_when: allowed scope/stop conditions/completion evidence are known
disable_when: requested action lies outside owning work item
actions.confirmation: none to prepare proposal; proposal must visibly state that execution has not occurred
actions.execution_contract: Create a bounded proposal/task packet containing source authority, exact scope, validations, stop conditions, candidate/base identity and required evidence.

result_contract.success: status is PREPARED or tool-defined READY_TO_EXECUTE only; never completed_verified
result_contract.failure: show missing prerequisite without inventing defaults

actions.mobile_touch: proposal summary keeps scope and stop conditions before handoff action

actions.label: Execute separately authorized mutation
enable_when: external governing authority explicitly permits this exact mutation
required preconditions and stop conditions are satisfied
disable_when: PPIA-16 is the only claimed authority
owner-only gate is required but absent
mutation outcome from prior attempt is unknown
actions.confirmation: required; display owning authority, exact targets/paths, candidate/base, expected result, rollback/recovery and validations
actions.execution_contract: Execute only through the separately authorized repository/application mechanism; no scope expansion or assertion weakening.

result_contract.success: capture exact resulting commit/operation/evidence identity; lifecycle remains unchanged until its owning gate says otherwise
result_contract.failure: record partial/failed state and recovery path; never erase attempt

actions.retry: only after proving prior operation did not apply or using owning idempotency/version mechanism
actions.keyboard: confirmation default is Cancel/Review, never Execute; destructive execution requires explicit activation
actions.mobile_touch: destructive/authoritative execution uses full-width labeled review step, not swipe or icon gesture

actions.label: Owner-only / irreversible gate
enable_when: owning policy/work order identifies an owner gate
explicit owner decision is recorded for the exact action/scope
actions.confirmation: always required even after recorded owner authorization; show decision source and irreversible/external effect
actions.execution_contract: Never auto-execute. The console may prepare evidence/request context before authorization, but execution remains an explicit owner-directed operation.

result_contract.success: record decision/execution evidence according to owning system; do not generalize authorization
result_contract.failure: preserve gate as unresolved/failed with no implicit retry

actions.retry: requires fresh owner authority when owning policy says so; never assume prior approval covers changed scope
actions.keyboard: owner gate is clearly distinguished from ordinary buttons and is never initial focused affirmative action
actions.mobile_touch: requires deliberate review screen and explicit action label

levels.use: large evidence run or non-destructive generated output with meaningful scope/cost

confirmation_model.rule: Confirmation cannot create authority. It only verifies deliberate execution of authority already established elsewhere.

triggers: runner/tool interruption after external adapter invocation
repository API timeout after mutation request
required_sequence: only then offer owning-domain recovery action
forbidden: mark failure solely from missing response
mark success solely from optimistic local state
